== Update, February 9, 2026 ==
Skill refinements:
* '''Spirit changes'''
** Fixed issue with spirit range increase.
** {{skill icon|Winnowing}} - Cast time 3s, duration upper bounds increased to 30-240s, range increased to 3500
** {{skill icon|Primal Echoes}} - Cast time 3s, duration upper bounds increased to 30-240s, range increased to 3500
** {{skill icon|Favorable Winds}} - Cast time 3s, duration upper bounds increased to 30-240s, range increased to 3500
** {{skill icon|Energizing Wind}} - Cast time 3s, duration upper bounds increased to 1-60s, range increased to 3500
** {{skill icon|Quickening Zephyr}} - Cast time 3s, duration upper bounds increased to 15..90s, range increased to 3500
** {{skill icon|Nature's Renewal}} - Cast time 3s, duration upper bounds increased to 30-240s, range increased to 3500
{{clear}}
*'''Spell implementation''':
**{{skill icon|Word of Censure}} had an implementation bug - the skill now works as described.
{{clear}}
''Also'' - the Steam-based in-game store is now fully available to Steam account-based players at the Character Select screen.
